result: PASS for the explicitly listed desktop synthetic-service scenarios
method: Desktop browser runtime QA with visible controls in frontend/qa/statistics-preview.mjs. Actual App, WelcomeEntry, StatisticsPanel and GoogleAccount components were used unchanged.
verified_cases: Guest entry hides statistics entrance and personal/overall tabs; direct #statistics remains gated and produces no statistics reads.
Statistics notice is visible before guest and account entry. Consent counter is zero before initial choice and increases after explicit entry choice.
Reloaded existing guest session shows entry notice without additional automatic consent.
Synthetic signed-in account can enter statistics from lobby; personal counts and overall counts match fixture values, and overall excludes personal score fields.
Statistics API failure shows an error instead of zero counts; retry after fixture recovery restores data.
Genuine empty response shows zero counts and the explicit no-qualified-matches message.
Actual production GoogleAccount unlink/logout button removes displayed statistics and returns guest-visible lobby.
Held statistics responses released after account invalidation do not restore stale statistics.
Browser session replacement clears previously displayed statistics and shows changed-session guidance and entry.
Authentication status failure hides statistics and entrance even at #statistics.
Consent submission failure keeps user at entry; retry after recovery succeeds.
Disabled statistics allows guest lobby entry without consent submission or statistics reads.
Restored active match remains displayed at #statistics without additional consent or statistics reads.
Browser back and forward restore appropriate statistics/lobby views.
Desktop personal and overall screenshots were visually inspected; no obvious overlap observed.
limitations: All API, Google identity and game WebSocket responses were synthetic. No live authentication, backend persistence or Google Sheets behavior was tested.
Desktop browser only. Mobile viewport and real-device responsiveness remain untested.
The standalone nine-scenario Playwright script was not successfully executed; this report records separate manual browser runtime checks.
Screenshots were visually inspected but not saved as separate files; no screenshot paths are claimed.
Active-room check verifies no new client consent submission and route replacement. It does not independently verify backend eligibility or migration behavior.
production_changes: None performed by this QA task. No deployment, push, real-account operation or real data writes.
